questions.text_english: The next (4th) term of the A.P. √18, √50, √98, … is :
questions.solution: The A.P. is √18, √50, √98, … which can be written as √(2×9), √(2×25), √(2×49), … = √2·3, √2·5, √2·7, … The terms under the root follow 2×3², 2×5², 2×7², so the next term is 2×9² = 2×81 = 162, giving √162. Option C is correct. Options A (√128), B (√140), and D (√200) do not fit this pattern.

questions.text: यदि x/3 = 2 sin A, y/3 = 2 cos A है, तो x² + y² का मान है :
questions.text_english: If x/3 = 2 sin A, y/3 = 2 cos A, then the value of x² + y² is :
questions.solution: From x/3 = 2 sin A, we get x = 6 sin A. From y/3 = 2 cos A, we get y = 6 cos A. Therefore x² + y² = 36 sin²A + 36 cos²A = 36(sin²A + cos²A) = 36 × 1 = 36. Option A is correct. The other options result from incorrect algebraic manipulation.

questions.text: यदि 4 sec θ – 5 = 0 है, तो cot θ का मान है :
questions.text_english: If 4 sec θ – 5 = 0, then the value of cot θ is :
questions.solution: 4 sec θ = 5, so sec θ = 5/4, meaning cos θ = 4/5. Using sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, sin²θ = 1 – 16/25 = 9/25, so sin θ = 3/5. Therefore cot θ = cos θ / sin θ = (4/5)/(3/5) = 4/3. Wait — that gives 4/3 which is option D. Let me recheck: cot θ = cos θ/sin θ = (4/5)/(3/5) = 4/3. The correct answer is D (4/3). Option A (3/4) would be tan θ, not cot θ.

questions.text: समीकरण निकाय 3x + 4y = 5 तथा 6x + 8y = 7 द्वारा निम्नलिखित में से किस प्रकार की सरल रेखाएँ निरूपित हो रही हैं ?
questions.text_english: Which out of the following type of straight lines will be represented by the system of equations 3x + 4y = 5 and 6x + 8y = 7 ?
questions.solution: For the equations 3x + 4y = 5 and 6x + 8y = 7, we compare ratios: a1/a2 = 3/6 = 1/2, b1/b2 = 4/8 = 1/2, c1/c2 = 5/7. Since a1/a2 = b1/b2 ≠ c1/c2, the lines are parallel and have no solution. Option A is correct. They are not coincident because c1/c2 ≠ 1/2, and they cannot intersect since the slopes are identical.
questions.chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
questions.topic: Graphical representation of pair of linear equations

questions.text: द्विघात समीकरण 5x² – 6x + 21 = 0 के मूलों के योगफल तथा गुणनफल में अनुपात है :
questions.text_english: The ratio of the sum and product of the roots of the quadratic equation 5x² – 6x + 21 = 0 is :
questions.solution: For 5x² – 6x + 21 = 0, sum of roots = –(–6)/5 = 6/5, and product of roots = 21/5. Ratio of sum to product = (6/5) : (21/5) = 6 : 21 = 2 : 7. Option B is correct. The other options arise from confusing the formula or swapping numerator and denominator.

questions.text_english: For the data 2, 9, x + 6, 2x + 3, 5, 10, 5; if the mean is 7, then the value of x is :
questions.solution: Sum of all values = 2 + 9 + (x+6) + (2x+3) + 5 + 10 + 5 = 40 + 3x. Number of values = 7. Mean = (40 + 3x)/7 = 7, so 40 + 3x = 49, giving 3x = 9, x = 3. Option D is correct.

questions.text: एक थैला, जिसमें 1 से 40 तक अंकित टिकटें हैं, में से यादृच्छया एक टिकट निकाली जाती है । निकाली गई टिकट की अंकित संख्या के 7 का गुणज होने की प्रायिकता है :
questions.text_english: One ticket is drawn at random from a bag containing tickets numbered 1 to 40. The probability that the selected ticket has a number which is a multiple of 7 is :
questions.solution: Multiples of 7 between 1 and 40 are: 7, 14, 21, 28, 35 — that is 5 numbers. Total tickets = 40. Probability = 5/40 = 1/8. Option B is correct. Wait — 5/40 = 1/8, so option B (1/8) is correct. Option C (1/5) would require 8 multiples. The correct answer is B.

questions.text: 21 cm त्रिज्या वाले वृत्त के उस त्रिज्यखंड, जो वृत्त के केन्द्र पर 60° का कोण अंतरित करता है, का परिमाप है :
questions.text_english: The perimeter of the sector of a circle of radius 21 cm which subtends an angle of 60° at the centre of circle, is :
questions.solution: Perimeter of sector = 2r + arc length = 2r + (θ/360°)×2πr. Arc length = (60/360)×2×(22/7)×21 = (1/6)×132 = 22 cm. Perimeter = 2×21 + 22 = 42 + 22 = 64 cm. Option C is correct.

questions.text: 12 cm त्रिज्या वाले वृत्त की एक चाप 10π cm लंबी है । इस चाप द्वारा वृत्त के केंद्र पर अंतरित कोण है :
questions.text_english: The length of an arc of a circle with radius 12 cm is 10π cm. The angle subtended by the arc at the centre of the circle, is :
questions.solution: Arc length = (θ/360°)×2πr. So 10π = (θ/360)×2π×12 = (θ/360)×24π. Therefore θ/360 = 10/24 = 5/12, giving θ = 5×360/12 = 150°. Option D is correct.

questions.text: वह बड़ी-से-बड़ी संख्या जो 281 तथा 1249 को भाग करने पर क्रमश: 5 तथा 7 शेषफल देती है, है :
questions.text_english: The greatest number which divides 281 and 1249, leaving remainder 5 and 7 respectively, is :
The number of terms in the A.P. 3, 6, 9, 12, …, 111 is :
questions.solution: Here a = 3, d = 3, last term l = 111. Using l = a + (n–1)d: 111 = 3 + (n–1)×3, so 108 = (n–1)×3, giving n–1 = 36, n = 37. Option C is correct.

questions.text: 10 cm त्रिज्या वाले एक वृत्त की एक जीवा, वृत्त के केंद्र पर समकोण अंतरित करती है । तो जीवा की लंबाई (cm में) है :
questions.text_english: A chord of a circle of radius 10 cm subtends a right angle at its centre. The length of the chord (in cm) is :
questions.image_description: Circle with centre O, chord AB subtending 90° at centre O. Radii OA and OB are each 10 cm.
questions.solution: The chord AB subtends 90° at centre O, with OA = OB = 10 cm. Using Pythagoras in triangle OAB: AB² = OA² + OB² = 100 + 100 = 200, so AB = √200 = 10√2 cm. Option B is correct.

questions.text_english: The LCM of three numbers 28, 44, 132 is :

questions.text: यदि दो सह-अभाज्य संख्याओं का गुणनफल 553 है, तो उनका म.स. (HCF) है :
questions.text_english: If the product of two co-prime numbers is 553, then their HCF is :
questions.solution: Co-prime numbers have no common factor other than 1. By definition, the HCF of two co-prime numbers is always 1, regardless of their product. Option A is correct. Options C and D (7 and 79) are factors of 553, but that does not make them the HCF of co-prime numbers.

questions.text: यदि α तथा β बहुपद p(x) = kx² – 30x + 45k के शून्यक हैं तथा α + β = αβ है, तो k का मान है :
questions.text_english: If α and β are the zeroes of the polynomial p(x) = kx² – 30x + 45k and α + β = αβ, then the value of k is :
questions.solution: Sum of zeroes α + β = 30/k. Product of zeroes αβ = 45k/k = 45. Given α + β = αβ: 30/k = 45, so k = 30/45 = 2/3. Option D is correct.

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, RJ तथा RL, वृत्त पर खींची गई दो स्पर्श-रेखाएँ हैं । यदि ∠RJL = 42° है, तो ∠JOL की माप है :
questions.text_english: In the given figure, RJ and RL are two tangents to the circle. If ∠RJL = 42°, then the measure of ∠JOL is :
questions.image_description: Circle with centre O. External point R from which two tangents RJ and RL are drawn touching the circle at J and L respectively. Angle RJL = 42° is marked.
questions.solution: Since RJ is a tangent at J, OJ ⊥ RJ, so ∠OJR = 90°. Therefore ∠OJL = 90° – 42° = 48°. Since OJ = OL (radii), triangle OJL is isosceles, so ∠OLJ = ∠OJL = 48°. Therefore ∠JOL = 180° – 48° – 48° = 84°. Alternatively, ∠JOL = 2×∠JRL's supplement... The inscribed angle theorem gives ∠JOL = 2×∠JRL. ∠JRL = 180° – 90° – 90° + ∠JRL. Using the property that ∠JOL + ∠JRL = 180°, and since in triangle RJL, ∠RJL = 42°, by symmetry ∠RLJ = 42°, so ∠JRL = 180° – 84° = 96°. Hence ∠JOL = 180° – 96° = 84°. Option B is correct.

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, △ ABC में, DE || BC है । यदि AD = 2·4 cm, DB = 4 cm तथा AE = 2 cm है, तो AC की लंबाई है :
questions.text_english: In the given figure, in △ ABC, DE || BC. If AD = 2·4 cm, DB = 4 cm and AE = 2 cm, then the length of AC is :
questions.image_description: Triangle ABC with DE parallel to BC, where D is on AB and E is on AC.
questions.solution: By the Basic Proportionality Theorem (Thales' theorem), AD/DB = AE/EC. So 2.4/4 = 2/EC, giving EC = 2×4/2.4 = 8/2.4 = 10/3 cm. Therefore AC = AE + EC = 2 + 10/3 = 6/3 + 10/3 = 16/3 cm. Option C is correct.

questions.text: यदि 7·5 m लंबा सीधा खड़ा खंभा भूमि पर 5 m लंबी छाया बनाता है और उसी समय एक मीनार की छाया की लंबाई 24 m है, तो मीनार की ऊँचाई है :
questions.text_english: If a vertical pole of length 7·5 m casts a shadow 5 m long on the ground and at the same time, a tower casts a shadow 24 m long, then the height of the tower is :
questions.solution: At the same time of day, the ratio of height to shadow is constant. Pole height/shadow = 7.5/5 = 1.5. Tower height = 1.5 × 24 = 36 m. Option D is correct.

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : ABCD एक समलंब है जिसमें DC || AB है । E तथा F क्रमशः AD तथा BC पर ऐसे बिंदु हैं कि EF || AB है । तो AE/ED = BF/FC ।
तर्क (R) : किसी समलंब की समांतर भुजाओं के समांतर कोई रेखा असमांतर भुजाओं को समानुपात में बाँटती है ।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A) : ABCD is a trapezium with DC || AB. E and F are points on AD and BC respectively, such that EF || AB. Then AE/ED = BF/FC.
Reason (R) : Any line parallel to parallel sides of a trapezium divides the non-parallel sides proportionally.
questions.instruction_line: नीचे दिए गए कोडों में से सही उत्तर चुनिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Select the correct answer from codes (A), (B), (C), (D) given below.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion A is true: in trapezium ABCD with DC∥AB, a line EF∥AB divides AD and BC proportionally, so AE/ED = BF/FC. Reason R is also true and it is precisely the theorem that directly explains why Assertion A holds. Both are true and R correctly explains A. Option A is correct.

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : शून्य बहुपद की घात परिभाषित नहीं है ।
तर्क (R) : एक शून्येतर अचर बहुपद की घात 0 होती है ।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A) : Degree of a zero polynomial is not defined.
Reason (R) : Degree of a non-zero constant polynomial is 0.
questions.instruction_line: नीचे दिए गए कोडों में से सही उत्तर चुनिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Select the correct answer from codes (A), (B), (C), (D) given below.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion A is true: the zero polynomial p(x) = 0 has no defined degree because every power of x is considered present with coefficient 0. Reason R is also true: a non-zero constant like p(x) = 5 has degree 0. However, R does not explain A — the two facts are independent properties of different cases. Both statements are true but R does not explain A. Option B is correct.

questions.text:
(a) यदि 3 cm त्रिज्या वाले एक वृत्त पर खींची गई दो स्पर्श-रेखाएँ परस्पर 60° के कोण पर झुकी हैं, तो प्रत्येक स्पर्श-रेखा की लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिए ।
अथवा
(b) सिद्ध कीजिए कि वृत्त के किसी व्यास के सिरों पर खींची गई स्पर्श-रेखाएँ परस्पर समांतर होती हैं ।
questions.text_english:
(a) If two tangents inclined at an angle of 60° are drawn to a circle of radius 3 cm, then find the length of each tangent.
OR
(b) Prove that the tangents drawn at the ends of a diameter of a circle are parallel.

key_points: Let external point be P, centre O, radius = 3 cm, angle between tangents = 60°
Angle between each tangent and line OP = 30°
tan 30° = radius / tangent length, so tangent = r/tan30° = 3/(1/√3) = 3√3 cm

questions.solution: Let the external point be P and the circle have centre O with radius OA = OB = 3 cm. The angle between the tangents is 60°, so ∠APB = 60°, meaning ∠APO = 30°. Since OA ⊥ PA, in right triangle OAP: tan 30° = OA/PA, giving PA = OA/tan 30° = 3/(1/√3) = 3√3 cm. Each tangent has length 3√3 cm.
questions.topic: Length of tangent from external point

questions.text: मान ज्ञात कीजिए : (2 tan 30° · sec 60° · tan 45°) / (1 – sin² 60°)
questions.text_english: Evaluate : (2 tan 30° · sec 60° · tan 45°) / (1 – sin² 60°)

key_points: Substitute standard values: tan30° = 1/√3, sec60° = 2, tan45° = 1, sin60° = √3/2

questions.solution: Using standard values: tan 30° = 1/√3, sec 60° = 2, tan 45° = 1, sin 60° = √3/2. Numerator = 2 × (1/√3) × 2 × 1 = 4/√3. Denominator = 1 – (√3/2)² = 1 – 3/4 = 1/4. Therefore the expression = (4/√3) ÷ (1/4) = 16/√3 = 16√3/3.

questions.text: यदि α, β बहुपद p(x) = 5x² – 6x + 1 के शून्यक हैं, तो α + β + αβ का मान ज्ञात कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: If α, β are zeroes of the polynomial p(x) = 5x² – 6x + 1, then find the value of α + β + αβ.
questions.solution: For p(x) = 5x² – 6x + 1, sum of zeroes α + β = –(–6)/5 = 6/5, and product of zeroes αβ = 1/5. Therefore α + β + αβ = 6/5 + 1/5 = 7/5.

questions.text:
(a) वह अनुपात ज्ञात कीजिए जिसमें बिंदु P(–4, 6), बिंदुओं A(–6, 10) तथा B(3, –8) को मिलाने वाले रेखाखंड को विभाजित करता है ।
अथवा
(b) सिद्ध कीजिए कि बिंदु (3, 0), (6, 4) तथा (–1, 3) एक समद्विबाहु त्रिभुज के शीर्ष हैं ।
questions.text_english:
(a) Find the ratio in which the point P(–4, 6) divides the line segment joining the points A(–6, 10) and B(3, –8).
OR
(b) Prove that the points (3, 0), (6, 4) and (–1, 3) are the vertices of an isosceles triangle.

key_points: Let P divide AB in ratio k:1

questions.solution: Let P(–4, 6) divide AB in ratio k:1. By section formula for x-coordinate: –4 = (3k + (–6)×1)/(k+1) = (3k–6)/(k+1). So –4(k+1) = 3k–6, giving –4k–4 = 3k–6, thus 2 = 7k, k = 2/7. The ratio is 2:7. Verifying with y: (–8×2/7 + 10×1)/(2/7+1) = (–16/7 + 10)/(9/7) = (54/7)/(9/7) = 6 ✓.

questions.text: एक डिब्बे में 60 कमीजें हैं, जिनमें 48 अच्छी कमीजें हैं, जबकि 8 में प्रमुख दोष हैं तथा 4 में छोटे दोष हैं । निगम, एक व्यापारी, केवल अच्छी कमीजें ही स्वीकार करता है, जबकि एक दूसरा व्यापारी अनमोल, केवल उन्हीं कमीजों को अस्वीकार करता है जिनमें प्रमुख दोष हों । डिब्बे में से यादृच्छया एक कमीज निकाली गई । प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए कि निकाली गई कमीज अनमोल को स्वीकार है ।
questions.text_english: A carton consists of 60 shirts of which 48 are good, 8 have major defects and 4 have minor defects. Nigam, a trader, will accept the shirts which are good but Anmol, another trader, will only reject the shirts which have major defects. One shirt is drawn at random from the carton. Find the probability that it is acceptable to Anmol.

key_points: Anmol rejects only shirts with major defects (8 shirts)
Anmol accepts good + minor defect shirts = 48 + 4 = 52

questions.solution: Anmol rejects only those shirts that have major defects. Number of shirts with major defects = 8. Therefore shirts acceptable to Anmol = 60 – 8 = 52 (good + minor defect shirts). Probability = 52/60 = 13/15.

questions.text:
(a) सिद्ध कीजिए कि √3 एक अपरिमेय संख्या है ।
अथवा
(b) सिद्ध कीजिए कि (√2 + √3)² एक अपरिमेय संख्या है, दिया गया है कि √6 एक अपरिमेय संख्या है ।
questions.text_english:
(a) Prove that √3 is an irrational number.
OR
(b) Prove that (√2 + √3)² is an irrational number, given that √6 is an irrational number.

key_points: Assume √3 = p/q where p, q are integers with no common factor
Then 3q² = p², so 3 divides p, let p = 3m
Then 3q² = 9m², so q² = 3m², meaning 3 divides q
This contradicts p and q having no common factor, so √3 is irrational

questions.solution: Assume √3 is rational, so √3 = p/q where p, q are integers, q ≠ 0, and HCF(p, q) = 1. Then 3 = p²/q², giving p² = 3q². So 3 divides p², and since 3 is prime, 3 divides p. Let p = 3m. Then 9m² = 3q², so q² = 3m², meaning 3 divides q. But then 3 is a common factor of both p and q, contradicting HCF(p, q) = 1. Hence √3 is irrational.

questions.text:
(a) यदि एक समांतर श्रेढ़ी के पहले 14 पदों का योगफल 1050 है तथा इसका प्रथम पद 10 है, तो इस समांतर श्रेढ़ी का 20वाँ पद तथा nवाँ पद ज्ञात कीजिए ।
अथवा
(b) एक समांतर श्रेढ़ी का प्रथम पद 5, अंतिम पद 45 तथा सभी पदों का योगफल 400 है । इस समांतर श्रेढ़ी के पदों की संख्या तथा सार्व अंतर ज्ञात कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
(a) If the sum of the first 14 terms of an A.P. is 1050 and the first term is 10, then find the 20th term and the nth term.
OR
(b) The first term of an A.P. is 5, the last term is 45 and the sum of all the terms is 400. Find the number of terms and the common difference of the A.P.
questions.solution: Given S₁₄ = 1050 and a = 10. Using Sₙ = n/2 × [2a + (n–1)d]: 1050 = 7 × [20 + 13d], giving 150 = 20 + 13d, so d = 10. The 20th term = a + 19d = 10 + 190 = 200. The nth term = a + (n–1)d = 10 + (n–1)×10 = 10n.
questions.topic: Sum of AP and nth term

questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि एक वृत्त के परिगत समांतर चतुर्भुज एक समचतुर्भुज होता है ।
questions.text_english: Prove that the parallelogram circumscribing a circle is a rhombus.

key_points: Tangents from an external point to a circle are equal in length
Let ABCD be a parallelogram circumscribing a circle; tangent lengths from each vertex are equal
AB + CD = AD + BC (sum of opposite sides equal)
In a parallelogram AB = CD and AD = BC, so 2AB = 2AD, giving AB = AD
All sides equal, so it is a rhombus

questions.solution: Let ABCD be a parallelogram circumscribing a circle with centre O, touching sides AB, BC, CD, DA at P, Q, R, S respectively. By the property of tangents from an external point: AP = AS, BP = BQ, CR = CQ, DR = DS. Adding: (AP+BP) + (CR+DR) = (AS+DS) + (BQ+CQ), giving AB + CD = AD + BC. Since ABCD is a parallelogram, AB = CD and AD = BC. So 2AB = 2AD, therefore AB = AD. Since adjacent sides are equal and it is already a parallelogram, ABCD is a rhombus.

questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि : tan A/(1 – cot A) + cot A/(1 – tan A) = 1 + sec A cosec A
questions.text_english: Prove that : tan A/(1 – cot A) + cot A/(1 – tan A) = 1 + sec A cosec A

key_points: Express tan A = sin A/cos A and cot A = cos A/sin A
Simplify each fraction and combine over common denominator
The LHS simplifies to (sin³A – cos³A)/[(sinA – cosA)sinAcosA]
Factor numerator using a³–b³ = (a–b)(a²+ab+b²) and cancel (sinA–cosA)

questions.solution: LHS = tanA/(1–cotA) + cotA/(1–tanA). Substituting tanA = sinA/cosA and cotA = cosA/sinA: first term = (sinA/cosA)/((sinA–cosA)/sinA) = sin²A/[cosA(sinA–cosA)]; second term = (cosA/sinA)/((cosA–sinA)/cosA) = cos²A/[sinA(cosA–sinA)] = –cos²A/[sinA(sinA–cosA)]. LHS = (sin³A – cos³A)/[sinAcosA(sinA–cosA)] = (sinA–cosA)(sin²A+sinAcosA+cos²A)/[sinAcosA(sinA–cosA)] = (1+sinAcosA)/(sinAcosA) = 1/(sinAcosA) + 1 = secAcosecA + 1 = RHS.

questions.text:
तीन निष्पक्ष सिक्के एक साथ उछाले गए । निम्नलिखित के प्राप्त करने की प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए :
(i) कम-से-कम एक चित
(ii) मात्र एक पट
(iii) दो चित तथा एक पट
questions.text_english:
Three unbiased coins are tossed simultaneously. Find the probability of getting :
(i) at least one head.
(ii) exactly one tail.
(iii) two heads and one tail.

key_points: P(at least one head) = 1 – P(no head) = 1 – 1/8 = 7/8

sub_questions.solution: Sample space has 2³ = 8 outcomes. Only one outcome has no heads (TTT). P(at least one head) = 1 – 1/8 = 7/8.

key_points: Outcomes with exactly one tail: HHT, HTH, THH — 3 outcomes

sub_questions.solution: Outcomes with exactly one tail: HHT, HTH, THH — that is 3 favourable outcomes. P(exactly one tail) = 3/8.
Outcomes with two heads and one tail: HHT, HTH, THH — 3 favourable outcomes. P(two heads and one tail) = 3/8.

questions.solution: Total outcomes when three coins are tossed = 2³ = 8: {HHH, HHT, HTH, HTT, THH, THT, TTH, TTT}. (i) At least one head: all except TTT = 7 outcomes, P = 7/8. (ii) Exactly one tail: HHT, HTH, THH = 3 outcomes, P = 3/8. (iii) Two heads and one tail: HHT, HTH, THH = 3 outcomes, P = 3/8.

questions.text: 10 cm त्रिज्या वाले वृत्त की एक चाप वृत्त के केंद्र पर समकोण बनाती है । तो संगत दीर्घ त्रिज्यखंड का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए । (π = 3·14 प्रयोग कीजिए)
questions.text_english: An arc of a circle of radius 10 cm subtends a right angle at the centre of the circle. Find the area of the corresponding major sector. (Use π = 3·14)

key_points: Minor sector angle = 90°, major sector angle = 270°
Area of major sector = (270/360) × π × r² = (3/4) × 3.14 × 100

questions.solution: The arc subtends 90° at the centre, so the minor sector has angle 90°. The major sector angle = 360° – 90° = 270°. Area of major sector = (270/360) × π × r² = (3/4) × 3.14 × 10² = (3/4) × 314 = 235.5 cm².

questions.text:
(a) 'k' का वह मान ज्ञात कीजिए जिसके लिए द्विघात समीकरण (k+1)x² – 6(k+1)x + 3(k+9) = 0, k ≠ –1 के वास्तविक और समान मूल हैं ।
अथवा
(b) एक व्यक्ति की आयु अपने बेटे की आयु के वर्ग की दुगुनी है । आठ वर्ष पश्चात्, इस व्यक्ति की आयु अपने बेटे की आयु के तीन गुने से 4 वर्ष अधिक होगी । उनकी वर्तमान आयु ज्ञात कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
(a) Find the value of 'k' for which the quadratic equation (k+1)x² – 6(k+1)x + 3(k+9) = 0, k ≠ –1 has real and equal roots.
OR
(b) The age of a man is twice the square of the age of his son. Eight years hence, the age of the man will be 4 years more than three times the age of his son. Find their present ages.
questions.solution: For real and equal roots, discriminant = 0. Here a = (k+1), b = –6(k+1), c = 3(k+9). D = b² – 4ac = 36(k+1)² – 12(k+1)(k+9) = 0. Factoring: 12(k+1)[3(k+1) – (k+9)] = 0, giving 12(k+1)(2k–6) = 0. Since k ≠ –1, we have 2k–6 = 0, so k = 3. Verifying: equation becomes 4x² – 24x + 36 = 0, i.e., x² – 6x + 9 = 0 = (x–3)², confirming equal roots x = 3.

questions.text: एक नदी के पुल के एक बिंदु से, नदी के सम्मुख किनारों के अवनमन कोण क्रमश: 30° और 60° हैं । यदि पुल, किनारों से 4 m की ऊँचाई पर हो, तो नदी की चौड़ाई ज्ञात कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: From a point on a bridge across the river, the angles of depressions of the banks on opposite sides of the river are 30° and 60° respectively. If the bridge is at a height of 4 m from the banks, find the width of the river.

key_points: Let P be the point on bridge, height = 4 m
Distance to bank 1: tan 60° = 4/d1, so d1 = 4/√3
Distance to bank 2: tan 30° = 4/d2, so d2 = 4√3

questions.solution: Let P be a point on the bridge at height 4 m. Let A and B be the two banks. Angle of depression to A = 60°, to B = 30°. In right triangle: tan 60° = 4/PA, so PA = 4/√3 = 4√3/3 m. tan 30° = 4/PB, so PB = 4/tan 30° = 4√3 m. Width of river = PA + PB = 4√3/3 + 4√3 = 4√3/3 + 12√3/3 = 16√3/3 m.

questions.text:
(a) दी गई आकृति में, △FEC ≅ △GDB तथा ∠1 = ∠2 है । सिद्ध कीजिए कि △ADE ~ △ABC.
अथवा
(b) एक △ABC की भुजाएँ AB और AC तथा माध्यिका AD क्रमशः एक अन्य त्रिभुज △PQR की भुजाओं PQ और PR तथा माध्यिका PM के समानुपाती हैं । दर्शाइए कि △ABC ~ △PQR.
questions.text_english:
(a) In the given figure, △FEC ≅ △GDB and ∠1 = ∠2. Prove that △ADE ~ △ABC.
OR
(b) Sides AB and AC and median AD of a △ABC are respectively proportional to sides PQ and PR and median PM of another △PQR. Show that △ABC ~ △PQR.

key_points: So BC – EC = BC – DB, giving BE = DC, meaning DE || BC
∠1 = ∠2 means ∠ADE = ∠AED (given), so AD = AE... actually ∠1 = ∠2 at D and E mean △ADE is isosceles

questions.image_description: Triangle ABC with points D on AB and E on AC. Line DE drawn. Points F and G are on a line through B and C extended. Angles 1 and 2 are marked at D and E respectively. Angles 3 and 4 are at B and G on the extended line.
questions.solution: Given △FEC ≅ △GDB, so EC = DB (CPCT). Since BC = BE + EC and BC = BD + DC, with EC = DB, we get BE = DC. In △ABC, since BE = DC, the point D divides AB and E divides AC such that DE ∥ BC (by the converse of BPT). Since DE ∥ BC, by corresponding angles: ∠ADE = ∠ABC and ∠AED = ∠ACB. With ∠A common, by AA criterion, △ADE ~ △ABC.

questions.text: लकड़ी के एक ठोस बेलन के प्रत्येक सिरे पर एक अर्धगोला खोद कर निकालते हुए, एक वस्तु बनाई गई है, जैसा कि आकृति में दिखाया गया है । यदि बेलन की ऊँचाई 5·8 cm है और इसके आधार की त्रिज्या 2·1 cm है, तो इस वस्तु का संपूर्ण पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: A wooden article was made by scooping out a hemisphere from each end of a solid cylinder, as shown in the figure. If the height of the cylinder is 5·8 cm and its base is of radius 2·1 cm, find the total surface area of the article.

key_points: TSA = Curved surface area of cylinder + 2 × curved surface area of hemisphere

questions.image_description: A solid cylinder with a hemisphere scooped out from each end. The cylinder has height 5.8 cm and radius 2.1 cm. The hemispherical cavities have the same radius as the cylinder base.
questions.solution: When hemispheres are scooped from each end, the flat circular faces of the cylinder are replaced by the curved surfaces of the hemispheres. Total surface area = Curved surface area of cylinder + 2 × Curved surface area of hemisphere = 2πrh + 2×(2πr²) = 2πr(h + 2r). With r = 2.1 cm, h = 5.8 cm: TSA = 2 × (22/7) × 2.1 × (5.8 + 4.2) = 2 × (22/7) × 2.1 × 10 = 2 × 22 × 0.3 × 10 = 2 × 66 = 132 cm².

questions.text:
एस्सेल वर्ल्ड भारत के सबसे बड़े मनोरंजन पार्कों में से एक है जो सभी उम्र के आगंतुकों के लिए रोमांचक सवारी, जल आकर्षण और मनोरंजन विकल्पों की एक विविध शृंखला प्रदान करता है । यह पार्क अपने प्रतिष्ठित "वॉटर किंगडम" के लिए जाना जाता है, जो इसे पारिवारिक सैर और मनोरंजन के लिए एक लोकप्रिय गंतव्य बनाता है । पार्क का टिकट शुल्क ₹ 150 प्रति बच्चा तथा ₹ 250 प्रति वयस्क है ।

एक दिन, पार्क के खजांची ने यह पाया कि 300 टिकट बिकी हैं तथा ₹ 55,000 एकत्र हुए हैं ।
questions.text_english:
Essel World is one of India's largest amusement parks that offers a diverse range of thrilling rides, water attractions and entertainment options for visitors of all ages. The park is known for its iconic "Water Kingdom" section, making it a popular destination for family outings and fun-filled adventure. The ticket charges for the park are ₹ 150 per child and ₹ 250 per adult.

On a day, the cashier of the park found that 300 tickets were sold and an amount of ₹ 55,000 was collected.
questions.instruction_line: उपर्युक्त के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: Based on the above, answer the following questions :

sub_questions.text: यदि उस दिन आए बच्चों की संख्या x तथा वयस्कों की संख्या y है, तो दी गई स्थिति को बीजगणितीय रूप में लिखिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: If the number of children visited be x and the number of adults visited be y, then write the given situation algebraically.
sub_questions.solution: The two equations are: x + y = 300 (total tickets) and 150x + 250y = 55000 (total amount collected).

sub_questions.text:
(a) इस मनोरंजन पार्क में उस दिन कितने बच्चे आए ?
अथवा
(b) इस मनोरंजन पार्क में उस दिन कितने वयस्क आए ?
sub_questions.text_english:
(a) How many children visited the amusement park that day ?
OR
(b) How many adults visited the amusement park that day ?
sub_questions.solution: From x + y = 300 and 150x + 250y = 55000 (dividing by 50: 3x + 5y = 1100). From the first equation x = 300 – y. Substituting: 3(300–y) + 5y = 1100, giving 900 + 2y = 1100, y = 100. So x = 200. That day, 200 children and 100 adults visited.

sub_questions.text: मनोरंजन पार्क में यदि 250 बच्चे तथा 100 वयस्क आए, तो कितनी राशि एकत्र होगी ?
sub_questions.text_english: How much amount will be collected if 250 children and 100 adults visit the amusement park ?

questions.image_description: Photo of Essel World amusement park showing roller coaster rides.
questions.solution: Case study on linear equations in two variables based on ticket sales at an amusement park. Answers provided in sub_questions.
questions.chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables

questions.text: एक बगीचा एक वर्ग के आकार का है । माली ने बगीचे की सीमा पर एक-दूसरे से 1 m की दूरी पर अशोक के पेड़ के पौधे उगाए । वह बगीचे को गुलाब के पौधों से सजाना चाहता है । उसने गुलाब के पौधे उगाने के लिए बगीचे के अन्दर एक त्रिभुजाकार क्षेत्र चुना । उपर्युक्त स्थिति में, माली ने कक्षा 10 के छात्रों की मदद ली जिन्होंने निम्न प्रकार का चार्ट बनाया ।
questions.text_english: A garden is in the shape of a square. The gardener grew saplings of Ashoka tree on the boundary of the garden at the distance of 1 m from each other. He wants to decorate the garden with rose plants. He chose a triangular region inside the garden to grow rose plants. In the above situation, the gardener took help from the students of class 10. They made a chart for it which looks like the given figure.
questions.instruction_line: उपर्युक्त के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: Based on the above, answer the following questions :

sub_questions.text: A को मूल-बिंदु लेकर, △PQR के शीर्षों के निर्देशांक क्या हैं ?
sub_questions.text_english: If A is taken as origin, what are the coordinates of the vertices of △PQR ?

key_points: Reading from chart: P(4, 6), Q(3, 2), R(6, 5)

sub_questions.solution: Taking A as origin and reading coordinates from the chart, the vertices of △PQR are P(4, 6), Q(3, 2) and R(6, 5).

sub_questions.text:
(a) दूरियाँ PQ तथा QR ज्ञात कीजिए ।
अथवा
(b) बिंदुओं P तथा R को मिलाने वाले रेखाखंड को 2 : 1 के अन्त: विभाजन करने वाले बिंदु के निर्देशांक ज्ञात कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english:
(a) Find distances PQ and QR.
OR
(b) Find the coordinates of the point which divides the line segment joining points P and R in the ratio 2 : 1 internally.

sub_questions.text: ज्ञात कीजिए कि क्या △PQR एक समद्विबाहु त्रिभुज है ।
sub_questions.text_english: Find out if △PQR is an isosceles triangle.

key_points: PQ = √17, QR = 3√2, PR = √5; all different, so not isosceles

sub_questions.solution: PR = √[(6–4)² + (5–6)²] = √[4+1] = √5. The three sides are PQ = √17, QR = 3√2 = √18, PR = √5. Since all three sides are different, △PQR is not an isosceles triangle.

questions.image_description: Square garden grid with boundary marked by dots (Ashoka saplings at 1 m apart). Triangular region PQR is shaded inside the garden. Vertices B, C, D and A are at corners of the square. Points P, Q, R are inside the grid.
questions.solution: Case study on coordinate geometry involving a triangular region in a square garden. Answers in sub_questions.

questions.text:
दौड़ने या साइकिल चलाने जैसी गतिविधियाँ तनाव और अवसाद जैसे मानसिक विकार के जोखिम को कम करती हैं । दौड़ने से सहनशक्ति बढ़ाने में मदद मिलती है । बच्चों की हड्डियाँ और मांसपेशियाँ मजबूत होती हैं और उनका वजन बढ़ने की संभावना कम होती है । एक स्कूल के शारीरिक शिक्षा शिक्षक ने अपने स्कूल परिसर में एक इंटर-स्कूल रनिंग प्रतियोगिता आयोजित करने का निर्णय लिया । छात्रों के समूह द्वारा 100 m की दौड़ में लिया गया समय नोट किया गया, जो निम्न प्रकार है :

समय (सेकण्ड में): 0–20, 20–40, 40–60, 60–80, 80–100
छात्रों की संख्या: 8, 10, 13, 6, 3
questions.text_english:
Activities like running or cycling reduce stress and the risk of mental disorders like depression. Running helps build endurance. Children develop stronger bones and muscles and are less prone to gain weight. The physical education teacher of a school has decided to conduct an inter school running tournament in his school premises. The time taken by a group of students to run 100 m, was noted as follows :

Time (in seconds): 0–20, 20–40, 40–60, 60–80, 80–100
Number of students: 8, 10, 13, 6, 3
questions.instruction_line: उपर्युक्त के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: Based on the above, answer the following questions :

sub_questions.text: ऊपर दिए गए आँकड़ों का माध्यक वर्ग क्या है ?
sub_questions.text_english: What is the median class of the above given data ?
sub_questions.solution: Total students = 40, so n/2 = 20. Cumulative frequencies: 0–20: 8; 0–40: 18; 0–60: 31. Since the 20th value falls in the class where cumulative frequency first exceeds 20, the median class is 40–60.

sub_questions.text:
(a) दौड़ पूरी करने में छात्रों द्वारा लिया गया माध्य समय ज्ञात कीजिए ।
अथवा
(b) ऊपर दिए गए आँकड़ों का बहुलक ज्ञात कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english:
(a) Find the mean time taken by the students to finish the race.
OR
(b) Find the mode of the above given data.

sub_questions.text: कितने छात्रों ने 60 सेकण्ड से कम समय लिया ?
sub_questions.text_english: How many students took time less than 60 seconds ?
sub_questions.solution: Number of students who took less than 60 seconds = students in classes 0–20, 20–40, and 40–60 = 8 + 10 + 13 = 31 students.

questions.image_description: Photo of students running on a track during a race competition.
questions.solution: Case study on statistics — mean, median, and mode for grouped data on race completion times. Answers in sub_questions.
